An '''Imperial garrison''' was established in the heart of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Reles]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] hoped to prevent the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from taking advantage of the economic divide among the citizens in Reles. A detainment center was located in the center of the garrison.<ref name="LotL" />

[[Heder Brant]], an Imperial officer in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], was stationed at the garrison on Spintir.<ref name="LotL" />
